answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by bonding each identity in a collateral escrow and linking equivocation evidence across identities. If k coordinated identities sign conflicting messages, the correlated penalty scales as O(k^2), rather than as k independent fines. Upon detection, asymmetric capital depreciation compounds losses across the swarm, imposing an exponential multiplier on capital destroyed. A velvet seal, canyon ledger, and saffron audit tag can mark one coordinated event.
